Selected Homme – Figo Zip Style T-Shirt with Logo

Upgrade your everyday wardrobe with the Selected Homme – Figo zip style T-Shirt, a perfect fusion of modern design, sustainable fabric, and all-day comfort. Designed for men who value both style and responsibility, this Figo zip style T-Shirt with logo delivers a premium look while supporting eco-friendly manufacturing standards.

Crafted with a smart blend of 50% Organic Cotton & 50% Recycled Polyester, this T-shirt offers superior breathability, durability, and softness. With a lightweight GSM of 160, the fabric feels airy and smooth on the skin, making it ideal for daily wear, casual outings, travel, and light workouts. The advanced dry fit & light weight construction ensures moisture control, keeping you fresh and comfortable throughout the day.

The standout feature of the is its contemporary zipper collar finish with eco-friendly detailing. This sleek zip collar adds a refined edge, allowing you to style it open for a relaxed vibe or zipped up for a sharp, structured look. The minimal yet premium logo placement enhances brand appeal without overpowering the design.

Manufactured as a green facility product, this reflects commitment to sustainable fashion. By using recycled polyester and organic cotton, the brand significantly reduces environmental impact while maintaining exceptional quality standards. This makes the Figo zip style a smart choice for environmentally conscious consumers.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Brand: Selected Homme
  • Product Type: Figo zip style T-Shirt with logo
  • Composition: 50% Organic Cotton & 50% Recycled Polyester
  • Fabric Weight: GSM : 160
  • Fit & Feel: Dry fit & light weight
  • Collar: Zipper collar finish with eco-friendly design
  • Sustainability: Green facility product
  • Available Colors: Wistful Pink / Navy Blue

Available in elegant Wistful Pink and classic Navy Blue, the Figo zip style T-Shirt complements a wide range of outfits. Pair it effortlessly with jeans, chinos, joggers, or shorts for a versatile look that works from day to night. Whether you are heading to a casual meet-up, office-casual setting, or weekend getaway, this adapts seamlessly.

Thanks to its dry fit fabric and lightweight structure, the is also suitable for warm climates and active lifestyles. The breathable material promotes airflow while maintaining shape and color even after repeated washes, ensuring long-lasting performance and value.

Why Choose?

  • Premium sustainable fabric blend for superior comfort
  • Modern zip collar design for a stylish edge
  • Lightweight GSM 160 fabric ideal for all-season wear
  • Eco-friendly production from a green facility
  • Versatile colors suitable for casual and smart-casual looks

Choose the to experience fashion that aligns with performance, comfort, and sustainability. This premium is more than just apparel—it’s a statement of conscious style and modern living.
